positions.name: QuantumDbMigrationRationale
positions.frame: what justifies the decision to migrate the analytics pipeline from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB?
positions.why: src-1 commits to the switch, src-2 supplies the performance and cost justification, and src-3 formalizes the decision with its performance gain and timeline — all three cohere under the single directional read of what grounds the PostgreSQL-to-QuantumDB migration. The set holds a mild tension between Dave Quantum's first-person commissive commitment (src-1) and Xena ExpertGH's third-person declarative summary (src-3), but both are read through the same question of justification.
